Surfaces of revolution

Source: R/layers-sweep.R
stat_revolve_3d.Rd

Turns each group's profile, given by the r aesthetic (distance from the axis) and the aesthetic of the axis (z for axis = "z"), about a line parallel to that axis through centre, in transformed position units. The profile rows are joined in order; closed = TRUE joins the last to the first (a torus from a circle). n angles cover angle degrees; a full turn wraps without a seam, and profile points at zero r become single poles. Normals point outwards where the profile runs towards increasing axis values. Numeric aesthetics are averaged over each face.

Usage

stat_revolve_3d(
  mapping = NULL,
  data = NULL,
  geom = GeomStatsSurface3D,
  position = "identity",
  ...,
  axis = c("z", "x", "y"),
  n = 48L,
  closed = FALSE,
  angle = c(0, 360),
  centre = c(0, 0),
  na.rm = FALSE,
  show.legend = NA,
  inherit.aes = TRUE
)

geom_revolve_3d(
  mapping = NULL,
  data = NULL,
  position = "identity",
  ...,
  axis = c("z", "x", "y"),
  n = 48L,
  closed = FALSE,
  angle = c(0, 360),
  centre = c(0, 0),
  na.rm = FALSE,
  show.legend = NA,
  inherit.aes = TRUE
)

Arguments

mapping, data, position, ..., na.rm, show.legend, inherit.aes

Standard layer arguments.

geom

Geom prototype for keyed triangle corners.

axis

Axis of revolution: "z" (r in the x-y plane), "x" or "y".

n

Number of angles.

closed

Whether the profile is a closed loop.

angle

Range of the revolution in degrees.

centre

Position of the axis in the other two coordinates, in the cyclic order (x, y), (y, z) or (z, x).

Value

A ggplot2 layer.

Examples

vase <- data.frame(h = seq(0, 2, length.out = 30))
vase$r <- 0.6 + 0.3 * sin(2.5 * vase$h) - 0.15 * vase$h
ggplot2::ggplot(vase, ggplot2::aes(r = r, z = h, fill = h)) +
  geom_revolve_3d(n = 36) + coord_3d()
